chunks: Whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār—may Allah have mercy on him—I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Aḥmad ibn al-Walīd—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: al-Ṣaffār, the named transmitter from whom reports are narrated
key_terms.الْوَلِيدِ: al-Walīd, part of the name of the intermediary transmitter in the chain
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a technical expression of hadith narration
key_terms.عَنْ: from; indicates transmission through a narrator in the isnad

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain from al-Ṣadūq to Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the transmission route used by the author for reports taken from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār. It documents an isnad link through Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Aḥmad ibn al-Walīd, making it relevant to hadith transmission and source authentication in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
